title: Split the Expression
statementMd:
You are given a string $s$ of the form `<block of digits>+<block of digits>+...+<block of digits>`. Every block of digits consists of at least $2$ and at most $13$ digits; every digit is from $1$ to $9$.

You have to split this string into expressions of the form `<integer>+<integer>`. Every expression must be a contiguous part of the given string, and every character of the given string must belong to exactly one expression. For example, if you have a string `123+456+789+555`, then:

- you are allowed to split it into `123+4`, `56+7` and `89+555`;
- you are not allowed to split it into `123+456` and `+789+555`, since the second part begins with a `+` sign;
- you are not allowed to split it into `123+4`, `56+7`, `8` and `9+555`, since the third part does not contain a `+` sign;
- you are not allowed to split it into `123+456+78` and `9+555`, since the first part contains two `+` signs.

Among all allowed ways to split the string, find one which maximizes the sum of results of all expressions you get, and print this sum.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 100$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of one line containing the string $s$ ($5 \le |s| \le 1000$) of the form `<block of digits>+<block of digits>+...+<block of digits>`. The string contains at least one '`+`' sign. Every block of digits consists of at least $2$ and at most $13$ digits; every digit is from $1$ to $9$.

## Output

For each test case, print one integer — the maximum possible sum of results of all expressions you get after splitting the string.

## Note

In the first test case of the example, you should split the string into expressions `123+4`, `56+7` and `89+555`. The sum of results of these expressions is $834$.

In the second test case of the example, the given string is already a valid expression and cannot be split any further.
statementZhMd:
你给定了一个形如 `<block of digits>+<block of digits>+...+<block of digits>` 的字符串 $s$。每个数字块由至少 $2$ 位、至多 $13$ 位数字组成；每一位数字均为 $1$ 到 $9$。

你需要将该字符串拆分成若干个形如 `<integer>+<integer>` 的表达式。每个表达式必须是给定字符串的一个连续部分，并且给定字符串中的每个字符必须恰好属于一个表达式。例如，对于字符串 `123+456+789+555`：

- 可以将其拆分为 `123+4`、`56+7` 和 `89+555`；
- 不能将其拆分为 `123+456` 和 `+789+555`，因为第二部分以 `+` 号开头；
- 不能将其拆分为 `123+4`、`56+7`、`8` 和 `9+555`，因为第三部分不包含 `+` 号；
- 不能将其拆分为 `123+456+78` 和 `9+555`，因为第一部分包含两个 `+` 号。

在所有合法的拆分方式中，找出一种使所有表达式的计算结果之和最大，并输出这个和。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 100$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例包含一行，其中给出一个形如 `<block of digits>+<block of digits>+...+<block of digits>` 的字符串 $s$（$5 \le |s| \le 1000$）。该字符串至少包含一个 '`+`' 号。每个数字块由至少 $2$ 位、至多 $13$ 位数字组成；每一位数字均为 $1$ 到 $9$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——将字符串拆分后得到的所有表达式的计算结果之和的最大值。

## 说明

在样例的第一个测试用例中，应将字符串拆分为表达式 `123+4`、`56+7` 和 `89+555`。这些表达式的计算结果之和为 $834$。

在样例的第二个测试用例中，给定的字符串已经是一个合法表达式，无法继续拆分。
